subject.title: [Feature]: Discord - auto-inject @mention for guild message replies

question: Should the Discord plugin add a default-off auto-mention policy that visibly mentions the original guild message author on replies, or should native replies plus explicit/alias mentions remain the supported behavior?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds notification policy and new config surface in an M4 Discord channel, so automation should not choose the product semantics alone.

options.title: Approve opt-in auto mention
options.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config that prefixes the original author mention only for safe guild replies, with duplicate, broadcast, and multi-bot safeguards.

options.title: Keep current notification model
options.body: Leave native Discord replies plus explicit or mentionAliases-based mentions as the supported behavior and close the request as not planned after documenting the boundary.

options.title: Require live proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a live multi-bot Discord reproduction and expected notification transcript before accepting new config surface.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in auto mention
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord plugin config that prefixes the original author mention only for safe guild replies, with duplicate, broadcast, and multi-bot safeguards.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current Discord mentionAliases config and send-layer rewrite path that this policy would most likely extend.
